seo.title: 12MP Glasses Drop in Dec 2026: 41g Frames, 9h Battery, 7x Recharge
seo.description:
Samsung will release 12-megapixel glasses in December 2026, featuring 41-gram frames that light up while recording. Google’s version arrives after a two-year wait, offers 9 hours of battery life, a case that recharges the frames seven times, and weighs 10 grams less than Meta’s model.
